title_en: Sparse inference and active learning of stochastic differential equations from data
title_zh: 从数据稀疏推断并主动学习随机微分方程

verified_metadata.title: Sparse inference and active learning of stochastic differential equations from data
verified_metadata.abstract: Automatic-threshold sparse Bayesian learning recovers differential-equation terms, while feedback control actively drives stochastic trajectories into under-sampled regions to improve global drift inference.
verified_metadata.comment: ArXiv v3 full text cross-checked with Scientific Reports metadata

sections.title: 作者信息
paragraphs: 作者 Yunfei Huang、Youssef Mabrouk、Gerhard Gompper、Benedikt Sabass；Scientific Reports 12, 21691 (2022)，DOI:10.1038/s41598-022-25638-9。核验 arXiv:2203.11010v3 全文17页。

sections.title: 研究问题
paragraphs: 从trajectory识别SDE drift/diffusion时，稀疏回归既要自动选threshold，又受metastable wells造成的phase-space sampling bias：粒子长期困在一个basin，只能局部知道force。能否用Bayesian sparsity稳定选项，并让当前推断反过来设计control perturbation主动探索未知区域？

sections.title: 背景
paragraphs: Kramers–Moyal coefficients D(1)、D(2)可由short-time increments估计，再表示为library Θ(z)与稀疏weights。作者采用Laplacian prior的Bayesian compressive sensing，并以train/test error迭代删除小weights，称ATSBL。
active loop AISO根据当前估计potential minima添加flattening control，生成新trajectory，去除已知control后重新推断uncontrolled drift。它要求能安全、准确施加外力，并假设control作用可从动力学中分离。

sections.title: 模型与方法
paragraphs: ATSBL把threshold candidates通过cross-validation式test error筛选，Laplacian prior相比Gaussian prior更强稀疏。对短SDE trajectories，binning与probability cutoff排除采样极少区域；同一framework还用于Lorenz ODE和reaction–diffusion PDE。
AISO在1D three-well和2D Mexican-hat-like force fields中循环：定位估计minimum、加入局部control使well变平、收集controlled samples、subtract control并更新global model。以coefficient deviation DIC评估每轮改善。

sections.title: 核心结果与证据
paragraphs: Figure 1的double-well SDE显示ATSBL从一条10^6-step noisy trajectory恢复drift与diffusion；Laplacian prior减少所需samples并更快threshold convergence。Figure 2说明short trajectory未访问区域的不确定性和binning cutoff作用。
Figure 3是主动学习主证据：无control的1D/2D trajectories困在局部区域；逐轮flatten estimated wells后覆盖扩大，DIC下降。2D streamlines从第一轮明显偏离真值，到第十轮pink identified field基本贴合black ground truth。
Figures 4–5在Lorenz和reaction–diffusion上展示ODE/PDE term discovery。所有ground truth与active-control结果来自simulation，论文没有真实在线实验或control-cost/safety benchmark。

sections.title: 有效性与局限
paragraphs: library必须含真实函数，finite-difference KM estimates要求足够小Δt且近似Markov/Itô；measurement noise、colored noise、hidden variables和rare transitions会偏置。threshold选于有限test split，不保证结构posterior calibration。
AISO依据当前错误模型设计control，可能把系统推向危险或model-invalid区域；本文control landscape可解析且模拟可reset。高维系统的potential minima搜索、actuator constraints和control/data tradeoff尚未解决。

sections.title: 复现与资源
paragraphs: 全文：https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.11010；期刊：https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-022-25638-9。PDF SHA-256：b34b22371e314236ef7e23c26e9cb3b15216c51bdd5de2082b3d71d18bd5d7d6。正文说明源码和数据可由通讯作者获取，未列公开仓库URL。

复现需固定Δt、trajectory length、library、Laplace hyperparameters、threshold grid/train-test split、bin cutoff、control amplitude/width、AISO iterations和DIC definition。Evidence status: full-text verified analytical/numerical study; no independent reproduction performed.
